purpose: Replace floating back-diagonal poses with grounded walking foot support.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent pixel-art game walk-cycle sprite sheet. Input reference: the attached hunter-diagonal-v1.png, especially its UPPER ROW showing the hunter from behind facing diagonally up and right. Make a corrected replacement for ONLY this back-three-quarter walking direction. Preserve the exact hunter identity, dark purple hood and cape, burgundy scarf, blonde side hair, brown boots, small orange belt charm, same pixel style, same proportions, empty hands. Output exactly SIX full-body walk poses arranged in a clean THREE-COLUMN by TWO-ROW grid, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Each cell has one same-size character at the same ground baseline with transparent padding and no overlapping cells. IMPORTANT CORRECTION: she must WALK ON THE GROUND, not jump, float, crouch or fly. In EVERY frame, one boot has its entire FLAT SOLE planted on the common baseline beneath the pelvis. The other leg takes a low natural step; alternate left/right support through contact, passing and opposite contact. Keep head/torso at stable height, legs visibly supporting the torso, small stride, scarf/cape subtly trailing. Keep the same back/up-right viewpoint in all six frames, about 45 degrees away from camera, with a tiny blonde side sliver, no frontal face. No shadows, floor, contact lines, labels, borders, weapons or effects. True transparent alpha background. Crisp pixel clusters, hard edges, restrained palette matching the input. This is a usable animation sheet, not a pose collage: consistent scale, sequential grounded steps, seamless looping.
refinement_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: attached six-frame back/up-right hunter sprite sheet. Preserve the hood, torso, cape, scarf, charm, hands, scale and back/up-right direction of every cell. Correct ONLY the LEG ANIMATION, which currently repeats the same bent pose and appears to float. Keep the exact 3-column x 2-row grid and six full-body sprites with transparent background. Make six visibly DIFFERENT successive grounded WALKING leg poses in reading order. Frame 1: near boot extended forward to the RIGHT, flat sole fully planted; far leg trails LEFT. Frame 2: near boot flat on ground directly UNDER the pelvis, far knee passes forward LOW. Frame 3: near boot behind the body LEFT with toe on ground, far boot reaching forward RIGHT. Frame 4: far boot extended forward RIGHT and flat on ground, near leg low trailing LEFT. Frame 5: far boot planted UNDER pelvis, near knee passing low forward. Frame 6: far foot back LEFT, near foot reaching forward RIGHT low to ground. These are alternating LEFT/RIGHT foot supports, not six copies of the same pose. Feet must be on a common ground baseline in every cell; at least one whole visible boot sole must clearly contact that baseline in every frame. One leg should look fairly straight and support body weight; no crouched/knees-both-retracted poses. Small natural walking stride, NO JUMPING, NO FLYING, no huge strides. Keep standing body proportions from the reference. No floor, shadows, ambient haze, text or grids. True transparent alpha around silhouettes, hard pixel edges matching the source art.
